## Rationale
- [S1705] (ARGUMENT/LIMITATION) Finding MT-5 (called the deepest measurement gap, upstream of MT-3 and MT-4): Roberts' measurement framework proceeds EmpiricalStructure -> Representation -> Scale -> MeaningfulOperations, and the corpus imports only the third and fourth stages, never executing the first -- no observable relation such as 'a is at least as well supported as b' is ever shown to satisfy the axioms (weak order, and for higher scales solvability/Archimedean) that would license any numerical representation at all; even the claim that sigma is 'at most ordinal' (MT-3) presupposes an ordinality that was assumed, never established; this is identified as exactly the gap the corpus's own day-one critique (kernel/20260825-184755 §12, 'Roberts answers when is a numerical quantity legitimately measurable') warned about, and the representation question was never returned to.
